pluss::subsp::stats::ts::DmOptions¶

Options of ts::dm_test.

DmOptions selects the loss, the horizon of the forecasts and the form of the test.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

horizon

std::int64_t

1

The forecast horizon h: the errors are correlated up to lag h − 1, which the long-run variance accounts for.

max_lag

std::int64_t

−1

Lags of the long-run variance; −1 means horizon − 1.

loss

ts::DmLoss

Squared

Squared, Absolute or Power (with loss_power).

loss_power

double

2

The exponent of the Power loss.

hln_adjust

bool

true

Apply the Harvey–Leybourne–Newbold small-sample correction and use a Student t reference; otherwise a normal.

tail

ts::DmTail

Both

Both, Left (first model better) or Right.

alpha

double

0.05

Significance level.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
